title: Navigable JSON: baked byte offsets for lazy agent reads
summary: Agents read JSON sequentially, so one record in a hundred costs all hundred. Navigable JSON bakes byte offsets at build time, so a reader skips bodies it does not need while the file stays valid JSON.

artifacts.note: the format article: motivation, field model, JSON Schema, reference linker and reader, a live-offset 5-record index, and validation with a live model
